title: 14th Annual Pershing Square Value Investing and Philanthropy Challenge
summary: The speaker argues that Pega (PEGA) represents a significant investment opportunity as it transitions from a legacy software model to a high-margin cloud business, potentially becoming a 'fifth bagger' with a target price of $310. In contrast, the speaker expresses a bearish view on Google (GOOGL), predicting it will remain a lead generation business vulnerable to disintermediation rather than investing in supply networks. Additionally, the talk highlights bullish positions on Home Depot (RH) regarding its shift off Google apps, Avalara (APTV) due to an underappreciated moat, and notes a specific recommendation error in the transcript where Avalara is listed with the ticker APTV.

claims.claim: The speaker believes Pega offers significant upside from their base case price target of $310 and views it as a visionary challenger in the SaaS space with potential to become a 'fifth bagger'.
claims.quote: we think pega offers significant upside from our base case so our base case price target of 310 dollars is based on seven and a half times 2026 revenues which assumes the multiple contracts slightly approaching its two-year historical average
claims.speaker: null

claims.claim: Pega is viewed as a legacy software solution trading at a discount compared to cloud-based subscription businesses like Zendesk or ServiceNow, but its valuation will reflect the transition as Pega Cloud becomes a majority of revenue.
claims.quote: despite showing a superior growth profile appears pega trades at a significant discount from our conversations with the sell side pega is viewed as a legacy software solution not a cloud-based subscription business like zendesk or servicenow
claims.speaker: null

claims.claim: In the bold case, the speaker expects Pega's valuation to translate to a 10 times even revenue multiple and an IRR of 34 over five years as the business transition completes.
claims.quote: in our bold case we think this translates to a 10 times even revenue multiple and an ir of 34 over five years so one of the risks is the timing of completing the cloud transition
claims.speaker: null

claims.claim: Pega has a terrific product, a sneaky customer base, and a clear path to the future, generating 20% IRR with upside potential of becoming a fifth bagger.
claims.quote: pega has a terrific product a sneaky customer base with a clear path to the future it's a visionary challenger in the sas place that can generate 20 ir with a upside potential of becoming a fightbagger
claims.speaker: null

claims.claim: Pega Cloud ACV is growing at a 60% CAGR during the transition, and demand continues to exceed expectations with some partners estimating 90% of new bookings are Pega Cloud.
claims.quote: pega cloud acv is growing at a 60 keger during the transition with growth accelerating in 2020 versus 2019 despite starting with a higher base currently this line of business makes up about 20 of total revenues however demand continues to exceed expectations with some partners we spoke to estimating 90 percent of new bookings are pega cloud
claims.speaker: null

claims.claim: Pega Cloud gross margins improved 1200 basis points in 2020 from 51 to 63, and the CFO expects them to be above 70 soon and above 75 plus when they exit the transition in 2022.
claims.quote: established cloud software businesses often have gross margins exceeding 75 percent mega cloud's ramping quickly gross margins improved 1200 basis points in 2020 from 51 to 63 and during our conversation with pega's cfo he mentioned they'll be above 70 soon and above 75 plus when they exit the transition in 2022
claims.speaker: null

claims.claim: Sales and marketing as a percentage of total revenue will decrease from 52 percent to 39 percent, and S&M margin will expand from negative six percent to 21 percent.
claims.quote: sales and marketing as a percentage of total revenue will decrease from 52 percent to 39 percent and ebay margin will expand from negative six percent to 21 which is still you know the mature fast-paced business margin of high 20 percent
claims.speaker: null

claims.claim: Pega has been growing revenues at 19% for the 10 years leading up to the transition, and ACV growth will begin coinciding with revenue growth which is encouraging.
claims.quote: it's shown that peg has been growing revenues at 19 for the 10 years leading up to the transition and then seemingly has fallen off in the last few years however a more reliable indicator for recurring revenues is the growth in annual contract value for acvs
claims.speaker: null

claims.claim: Pega sustains a unique position with high retention products, achieving a dollar retention of 115% in contrast to Salesforce's dollar retention of around 90%.
claims.quote: pega also differentiates from major competitors like salesforce by providing complex workflow management real-time precision higher roi and smooth integration this supports peta's dollar retention of a hundred and fifteen percent in contrast to salesforce dollar retention of around ninety percent
claims.speaker: null

claims.claim: According to Gartner, Pega is a clear BPM leader and is also among CRM leaders in emerging subsectors like low code and RPA.
claims.quote: according to gartner pegger is a clear bpm leader and is also among crm leaders in emerging subsectors like low code and rpa there there's still no clear leaders now and pega is visionary
claims.speaker: null

claims.claim: Pega is among the leaders in a fast-growing industry where the term is around $80 billion, of which $50 billion are serviceable for Pega, and this serviceable market will grow at 18% CAGR.
claims.quote: our first thesis is that pega is among the leaders in a fast growing industry the term is around 80 billion of which 50 billion are serviceable for pega considering client size and verticals and this serviceable market will grow at 18 percent category
claims.speaker: null

claims.claim: Pega Cloud ACV is growing at a 60% CAGR during the transition, and the strong performance and sustained demand will push the revenue mix towards Pega Cloud which becomes about 60% of revenues in the exit year 2026.
claims.quote: pega cloud acv is growing at a 60 keger during the transition with growth accelerating in 2020 versus 2019 despite starting with a higher base currently this line of business makes up about 20 of total revenues however demand continues to exceed expectations with some partners we spoke to estimating 90 percent of new bookings are pega cloud and the strong performance and sustained demand will push the revenue mix towards pega cloud which we think becomes about 60 of revenues in our exit year 2026
claims.speaker: null

claims.claim: The speaker believes Google will not invest in sourcing supply networks and will remain a lead gen business, making it vulnerable to disintermediation.
claims.quote: i think what we are super excited about this opportunity is once you kind of move it off app and kind of develop this habit then you kind of disintermediate google and google is not going to be in the business of being able to source supply

claims.claim: The speaker identifies HomeAdvisor and Angie's List as top suppliers for RH, noting they are historically called a Google arbitrage place but are moving off apps.
claims.quote: in terms of like where they show up yeah home advisor or angie's usually one of the first two or three at the top of the list and that's why people have historically called them a google arbitrage place

claims.claim: The team recommends a long position on Avalara with a price target of $850, implying a six times return on money.
claims.quote: we're recommending a long on avalara with a price target of 850 dollars this implies a six times return on your money roughly 20 irr

claims.claim: The speaker believes the market is underappreciating Avalara's moat, growth opportunities, and partnerships, leading to an overweight stance.
claims.quote: touching our variant view we think the market's under appreciating avalara's moat growth opportunities and the importance of its partnerships it's overweighing the threat of new entrants

claims.claim: The speaker projects Avalara's mid-market penetration will expand from single digits to around 40% by 2030.
claims.quote: we think they can expand penetration from single digits today to around 40 by 2030
